messages:
lauren-partnerops: Partner 'VertexGrid' opened a ticket - their marketplace usage shows unexpected spikes tied to a new SI integration. They sent sample webhook lines.
kevin-revops: looking at logs, spikes are tied to events with sku 'MKT-STD' but varying entitlement_id values that we treat as distinct customers. suspect serialization bug on partner side.
matt-plateng: can you paste sample?
lauren-partnerops: redacted snippet:
```
{customer_id: 'vg-999', event_ts: '2026-03-22T14:02Z', entitlement_id: 'ent-abc-1', units: 120}
{customer_id: 'vg-999', event_ts: '2026-03-22T14:02Z', entitlement_id: 'ent-abc-1 ', units: 0}
{customer_id: 'vg-999', event_ts: '2026-03-22T14:02Z', entitlement_id: 'ENT-ABC-1', units: 5}
```
olga-support: noticed trailing spaces and case differences; ledger-bridge currently uses raw entitlement_id as dedupe key. this causes duplicates.
kevin-revops: short term: normalize entitlement_id by trimming and lowercasing at ingest and add fingerprint field entitlement_fingerprint. treat normalized entitlements as same for billing.
matt-plateng: agree. Also propose hold for any >0 events where multiple distinct entitlement_ids map to same fingerprint within 1 minute - route to recon queue.
lauren-partnerops: partner needs clarity: will we bill duplicates?
kevin-revops: with normalization and hold, duplicates won't appear in committed billing; we'll show them in a "recon_candidates" export for partner review.
olga-support: partner-facing fix: provide their SI an integration patch and a validation test they can run pre-deploy. also include sample mapping rules in docs.
partnerbot: webhook delivered 200 OK to /marketplace/webhook. signature validated.
matt-plateng: owners: matt -> ingest normalization by EOD, kevin -> aggregation/hold rules by Thursday, lauren -> partner comms and SI patch coordination by Wednesday.
lauren-partnerops: will schedule a joint call with VertexGrid and their SI for tomorrow. thanks team.
thread_text_snippet: VertexGrid spikes due to entitlement_id formatting differences; plan: normalize entitlement_id, add fingerprint, hold ambiguous >0 events for recon, provide SI patch and docs
